parameters.content:
## Satyer News Auto — নাজিরাবাজার (সত্যের প্রহর) — INACTIVE
Jony's decisions (3 Nov 2026): DIRECT auto-post, NO approval step (explicit override of the per-post approval rule, FOR THIS NEWS WORKFLOW ONLY); ALL trending/discussed Bangla news, all topics; NO Airtable — dedup + log in /agency/news-log.json on Max.
Schedule: 08:30 and 20:30 Asia/Dhaka (BD prime time, morning 8-9am + evening 8-9:30pm).
Flow: 10 verified RSS feeds -> Merge -> Filter Fresh (dedup vs log, cap 6) -> Gemini writer (max 3 posts) -> Facebook Post -> Wait 10 min -> Facebook Comment with source link -> Log Run.
KEYS TO PASTE (in n8n UI, never in chat):
1. 'Gemini Writer' node: header x-goog-api-key = your Gemini API key.
2. 'Facebook Post' node: replace PASTE_PAGE_ID_HERE in the URL with the নাজিরাবাজার Page ID.
3. 'Facebook Post' + 'Facebook Comment' nodes: header Authorization Bearer PASTE_FB_PAGE_TOKEN_HERE = Page Access Token.
Workflow stays INACTIVE until keys are pasted AND Jony says activate. Do NOT run end-to-end before that.
Tag: news-auto (separate from the video pipeline workflows).

## RSS feeds — verified live from Max, 3 Nov 2026
Working (10): Prothom Alo, BBC Bangla, Daily Star Bangla, Ajker Patrika, Google News Bangla (top), Google News 'বাংলাদেশ', NTV, Ittefaq, BanglaNews24, TBS Bangla.
DROPPED as dead/blocked: Jugantor, Kaler Kantho, Samakal, JagoNews24, Ekattor, BD Pratidin, Inqilab (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' — n8n cannot pass it), RTV (403), Somoy (RSS URL returns HTML), Jamuna/Channel 24/DBC (connection fails), DW Bangla + VOA Bangla + Al Jazeera Bangla (no working RSS found). Note: the two Google News feeds aggregate the blocked sites, so their stories still surface.
To add a feed later: add an RSS Read node, connect it to Merge Items, re-verify the URL first.
